questions.q: What was the first thing the Doctor did when he found so many sick monkeys?
choices: He sent messages to the lions and leopards asking them for help
He separated the sick monkeys from the well ones
He built a big house full of beds for all the monkeys to sleep in
He went to bed and slept for three whole days without waking
questions.evidence: The first thing he did was to separate the sick ones from the well ones.

questions.q: What did the Doctor do for the monkeys who were still well?
choices: Gave them bitter medicine to drink every morning
Vaccinated them
Sent them far away into the hills
Gave them all a bath and a brushing
questions.evidence: he made all the monkeys who were still well come and be vaccinated

questions.q: Why did the Doctor need the other animals to come and help?
choices: There were so many sick monkeys that there were not enough well ones to nurse them
The lions and leopards were the only animals who knew how to make medicine
The monkeys were afraid of the Doctor and would not let him come near them
The Doctor had hurt his leg falling in the mud and could not walk around
questions.evidence: there were not enough well ones to do the nursing

questions.q: How did the Leader of the Lions act when the Doctor first asked for help?
choices: He was shy and timid and said he had never been a nurse before
He was proud and scornful and refused to wait on the monkeys
He was kind and said he would bring all his friends to help at once
He was frightened and ran off because he thought the Doctor was angry
questions.evidence: Do you dare to ask me--ME, THE KING OF BEASTS, to wait on a lot of dirty monkeys?

questions.q: What did the Doctor warn the lion might happen if the lions did not help now?
choices: The monkeys would never let lions hunt in the jungle again
The Doctor would tell all the animals in Africa how rude he was
The lions might be left all alone when they were in trouble
The King of the Jolliginki would send soldiers to catch them
questions.evidence: the lions may find themselves left all alone when THEY are in trouble

questions.q: What did the antelopes do when they were asked to help?
choices: Ran off into the hills as fast as they could go
Pawed the ground, smiled foolishly and said they had never been nurses
Roared at the Doctor and said that the monkeys were much too dirty to touch
Said they would come later, after they had eaten their dinner
questions.evidence: said they had never been nurses before

questions.q: What was waiting for the Leader of the Lions when he got back to his den?
choices: The leopards, who wanted to know what the Doctor had said
His wife, upset because one of the cubs would not eat
A message from the Doctor saying he was sorry
Two monkeys, sent to ask him again to help with the nursing
questions.evidence: One of the cubs won't eat

questions.q: Why was the Queen Lioness so angry with her husband?
choices: He had forgotten to bring any food home for the cubs that day
He had been rude to the one good doctor just when their cub was sick
He had promised to help the Doctor without asking her first
He had told the leopards and antelopes not to help the monkeys
questions.evidence: Nobody but a fool is ever rude to a GOOD doctor.

questions.q: When the lion came back, he said, "I happened to be passing this way." What does this show?
choices: He really had been out hunting and only stopped by by chance
He was too proud to say that his wife had sent him back to say sorry
He wanted to check whether the monkeys were truly as dirty as he thought
He had come to tell the Doctor to leave Africa right away
questions.evidence: I happened to be passing this way and thought I'd look in.

questions.q: What did the Doctor do once the last monkey was well?
choices: He held a great feast for all the animals who had helped him
He went straight to the lion's den to see the sick cub
He went to bed and slept for three days without turning over
He began packing his trunk to sail home to Puddleby that night
questions.evidence: slept for three days without even turning over

questions.q: What is this chapter mostly about?
choices: How the Queen Lioness scolded her husband and then went to tell the lioness next door
How the Doctor cured the monkeys, with help from a proud lion who changed his mind
How the antelopes and the leopards became good friends with the monkeys
How the Doctor built two houses of grass in the jungle
questions.evidence: And now very soon the monkeys began to get better.
